Model cost is total port expenditure divided by total rated power. Aggregated infrastructure retains manual annual utilization 0.20/0.30 for LDV/MHDV; explicit archetypes derive utilization from matched operating inputs and a separately sourced home proxy. Source-specific endpoint holds remain explicit.

These values are distinct from explicit type-specific utilization derived from operating inputs. The original rounded MHDV duration/throughput and 80/20 mix rationale remains in the manual input for audit.
